description: Application for Certificate of Lawfulness (Proposed) for internal alterations within non-statutorily listed building including to provide step-free access to all but basement levels, increased sanitary provision including wheelchair access wcs on all but basement levels and independently supported mezzanine floor at balcony level; and change of use from Class F1(f) Public worship or religious instruction (or in connection with such use) to Class F1 (a) the provision of education, (b) the display of works of art (otherwise than for sale or hire), and (e) a public hall or exhibition hall.
